subject: Discovery follow-up and pilot onramp blueprint
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@heliumai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up and pilot onramp blueprint

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for an efficient 30 min today. Quick recap to make sure we’re aligned and to propose concrete next steps for a 4-week pilot. If anything below is off, flag it and we’ll adjust.

Key pain points you articulated
- High false positive rate (>20%) on ingestion classification causing manual review backlog
- Latency sensitivity for near-real-time enrichment (target p95 < 400ms)
- Concerns about hosting/data isolation and audit trails for regulated customers

Success metrics you care about
- Reduce manual review volume by 40% (measured by downstream queue size)
- Maintain or improve precision at the same recall baseline
- End-to-end p95 latency < 400ms for enrichment step
- Clear auditability: token-level logs retained for 90 days (or HSM/KMS integration for keys)

Proposed 4-week pilot scope (what we will run)
1) Week 0: Access & sandboxing: provide VPC peering instructions + temporary read-only sample ingestion (10k records).
2) Week 1: Baseline evaluation on your sample set (metrics: precision/recall, throughput, latency).
3) Week 2: Prompt set + model tuning pass; evaluate quality regressions with Redwood Optimize.
4) Week 3: Run acceptance sweep; handoff ops runbook + next-step pricing/ Dedicated capacity discussion.

Owners
- Redwood AE / Engagement: Karthik (me) — commercial & success lead
- Technical onboarding & runtime: Marissa Cole — infra and access owner
- HeliumAI: Claire — product owner; Eng contact: eng-team@heliumai.com

Initial asks for HeliumAI (before Week 0)
- Provide a 10k sample CSV (anonymized) + 200 labeled examples for eval (label schema doc would be ideal)
- Confirm SLA requirements for inference (target p95 latency) and data residency rules
- Point person for account VPN/VPC/networking (for Marissa to loop in)

Attachments I will share now (stubs below)
- prompt_set_v1.csv (starter prompts and labeling snippets)
- redwood_poc_sow.docx (scope, acceptance criteria, and estimated cost)

Proposed meeting cadence
- Weekly 30m sync (Tues 10am PT) + ad-hoc slack for blockers

Next steps (concrete)
1) Claire: confirm sample delivery timeline and networking contact by EOD Tue 11/24
2) Karthik/Marissa: send SOW and access checklist (attached) + set calendar invite for kickoff

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: prompt_set_v1.csv (CSV, 12KB)]
[Attachment: redwood_poc_sow.docx (DOCX, 48KB)]

From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@heliumai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up and pilot onramp blueprint

Thanks Karthik — this is clear and helpful. Quick clarifications before we commit:

- Sample data: we can deliver the 10k anonymized CSV by Friday 11/26. The 200 labeled examples will be a best-effort by the same date.
- Latency: 400ms p95 is our stretch target; the hard requirement is p95 under 600ms.
- Data residency: must remain within our US account; if Redwood needs keys, we prefer KMS integration rather than shared keys.

One ask: can you confirm whether Redwood will run evaluation against the whole sample or a holdout split? We’d like to understand the acceptance criteria calculations. Also please surface any required network IPs for the VPC peering so our infra person can unblock.

If that all looks reasonable I’ll confirm the networking contact (probably Raj Patel, infra) and we can lock the kickoff.

—Claire
Claire Zhang
Head of Product | HeliumAI
claire.zhang@heliumai.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@heliumai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up and pilot onramp blueprint

Great — thanks for the quick answers, Claire. Short answers to your questions and confirmatory notes below.

- Evaluation split: we’ll run a 80/20 holdout. Metrics reported in the SOW are calculated on the holdout set; we’ll share the evaluation notebook and exact code so you can reproduce.
- Latency: we will design configuration to target p95 < 400ms in our hosted environment; for Dedicated capacity we can include additional buffer. We’ll include the separate SLA options in the SOW.
- KMS: we support KMS/HSM integrations. Marissa will follow up with requirements and our KMS connector doc.

I’ve attached the pilot SOW and a starter prompt set. Attachment stubs included below as well.

Proposed kickoff date: Mon 11/29 10am PT — if that works for Raj and your infra team we’ll block it.

Action items now
- Claire: share Raj’s contact and the sample CSV by 11/26
- Marissa: begin VPC peering checklist and share IP ranges
- Connor: will prepare the onboarding playbook and test account details

Thanks — I’ll send calendar invites after Raj confirms.

Best,
Karthik
[Attachment: redwood_poc_sow.docx (DOCX, 48KB)]
[Attachment: prompt_set_v1.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@heliumai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up and pilot onramp blueprint — ops kickoff checklist

Hi Claire — looping in the ops checklist and a short network checklist to make kickoff smooth. I’ll be your point for network/VPC and access.

Short network checklist
- Please confirm Raj Patel (raj.patel@heliumai.com) as your infra contact.
- We need a CIDR range preference for the peer, and a list of IP ranges if you have firewall rules.
- If you prefer VPC peering or PrivateLink, indicate preference; we typically recommend VPC peering for pilots.

Access & accounts
- We’ll create a sandbox service account (read-only ingestion + evaluation) and invite two HeliumAI users to the Redwood Console. Please provide their emails.
- If you want KMS-backed encryption, please confirm the KMS ARN or we can use Redwood-managed keys temporarily (we require written approval).

Attachments included
- access_playbook.pdf (network steps, minimal IAM policies, and port/IP list)

I’ll schedule a 30m technical kickoff once Raj confirms availability — proposed: Mon 11/29 10am PT (matches Karthik’s note)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Technical Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: access_playbook.pdf (PDF, 152KB)]
